Windows (x64) build of PhoneDeck. Unzip `phonedeck-windows-x64.zip` and run `phonedeck.exe`.

- Needs a Bluetooth adapter that supports the peripheral role, and Chrome on an Android phone.
- The program is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn. Choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
- `phonedeck-windows-x64.zip.sha256` is the SHA-256 of the zip, for checking the download.

The source and the documentation are in the repository.
